product_one_liner.value: Bitly helps brands and businesses create branded short links and QR Codes, then track and analyze clicks and scans.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes link and QR Code creation and tracking; the pricing page identifies brands and businesses as its audience.

pricing_page.notes: Bitly publishes a pricing page with plan information.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in Bitly customer-story materials.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists Bitly’s company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists New York, NY as headquarters, and Bitly’s contact page labels its New York address as the US headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Bitly states that it was founded in 2008.

eng_blog.notes: Bitly has technical posts about NSQ distributed message processing and frontend dependency management with Browserify.

public_docs.notes: Bitly has a public developer portal with API documentation and reference material.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Bitly’s Greenhouse careers board says there are no current openings.

model_provider.notes: Bitly describes Bitly Assist and integrations with external AI assistants, but the reviewed product, help, and AI materials do not identify the underlying model/provider powering Bitly Assist.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center claims SOC 2 compliance and GDPR compliance.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile identifies a $63 million growth investment in July 2017.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent funding event shown is the July 2017 growth investment, outside the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Bitly’s careers board says there are no current openings.

launched_6mo.notes: Bitly’s updates page describes a September 2026 AI-traffic card for individual links, a new analytics feature within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Bitly announced Matt Young’s appointment as CTO on March 19, 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Bitly customer case page lists Salesforce and Marketo among integrations, and Bitly has a Salesforce integration page.
